==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I am in a futuristic city. I am a detective. My name is Wolf.

I am searching for a rogue AI. It has a holographic body. It can shapeshift and it has the power to trap people in the digital world.

I encounter a woman. When I ask her what her name is, she starts to glitch out and repeat two different names over and over again. I suddenly can hear my nose whistling in the waking world, and I wake up.
